info.name: DT-MIS Salesforce Push API
info.description: POST /api/integrations/salesforce/push. No login: every request is HMAC-signed. Set the variables baseUrl and pushSecret (collection Variables tab), then run the collection. The collection pre-request script adds X-DT-Timestamp and X-DT-Signature automatically. Sample data is synthetic; run against a test environment.

exec: // Signs every request: X-DT-Signature = sha256=hex(HMAC-SHA256(secret, timestamp + '.' + rawBody))
if (!secret) { throw new Error('Set the collection variable pushSecret first.'); }
const mode = pm.request.headers.get('X-Test-Case'); // negative-test switch, removed before sending
const body = pm.variables.replaceIn(raw); // signed text must equal what is sent
